['Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value', 'From activities', 'Join assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', 'Join molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Join compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', "Filter activities.standard_relation = '='", 'Filter activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL', "Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1250411'", "Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'", "Filter target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'", "Filter activities.type = 'IC50'", 'Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value', 'Sort by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id', 'Limit 1000']
